summary: Frontend-only testing of Arabic RTL Saudi Embassy office marketing site. Verified homepage sections, hero slider dots, header/mobile nav, smooth scroll, service cards, FAQ accordion toggling, WhatsApp/tel href correctness, legal routes (/privacy, /terms, /disclaimer) with back link, and responsive layout (1920, 768, 390). No console errors. RTL direction confirmed (dir=rtl). All data-testid selectors present and functional.

issues: FAQ item 0 appears to be expanded by default on load — first click on faq-question-0 collapsed it (visible=false), second click re-opened. Toggle logic is correct, but initial open state may be intentional; verify if desired UX.

critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx likely renders duplicate data-testid values for desktop and mobile nav links (e.g., nav-link-contact appears in both desktop-hidden nav and mobile menu). While functional, duplicate data-testid across DOM can complicate future automated testing. Consider suffixing with -mobile or using a single conditional render.
All WhatsApp buttons share an identical prefilled Arabic text query param — acceptable, but consider varying the message per CTA (e.g., hero vs services) for richer analytics/UX.
Legal pages share the same <title>; consider setting per-page titles for SEO (Privacy/Terms/Disclaimer).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static Arabic RTL React marketing site. Frontend URL: https://saudi-services-hub-2.preview.emergentagent.com. All key data-testid selectors verified present. Backend not consumed by frontend; skip backend testing unless explicitly requested. Mobile menu opens via menu-open-btn and closes via menu-close-btn. Duplicate data-testid values exist across desktop-hidden and mobile nav — when clicking, prefer the visible one (use is_visible checks or scope to the open drawer).
